List gournal journal entries (newest first), optionally filtered by project, tags, and/or a date range (inclusive, ISO timestamps). Capped at `limit` entries to avoid flooding the caller's context. The text result is JSON.

## Input

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `project` | `string` | no | Filter to a single project name |
| `tags` | `string[]` | no | Filter to entries containing all of these tags |
| `from` | `string` | no | ISO timestamp lower bound (inclusive) |
| `to` | `string` | no | ISO timestamp upper bound (inclusive) |
| `limit` | `integer` | no | Max entries to return, newest first (default 50, max 500) Default: `50`. |

## Output

This tool returns structured output. The shape is the [Entry list](/gournal/docs/reference/mcp/output-shapes/#entry-list).
